name: rear lunge from deficit
description: A reverse lunge starting from a raised platform so you go deeper. Great for glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand on a low step with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and down off the step.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep your torso tall and front knee stable.
Push through the front heel to return to the step.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
